natural_input.description: Draw the stable softmax algorithm dependency graph, with no hardware mapping. Only X, Reduce Max, Subtract, Exponential, Reduce Sum, Divide, Y. Divide produces Y_i=E_i/s from Exponential E_i and Reduce Sum s. Reduce Sum computes s=sum_i E_i from Exponential. Exponential computes E_i=exp(Z_i) from Subtract. Subtract computes Z_i=X_i-m from both X and Reduce Max. Reduce Max computes m=max_i X_i from X. X is a vector N.
